verdict.summary: The implementation remains correct and complete. The producer validates the full per-fire evidence list, counts only links that survive the GitHub pin, caps the published slice at five, and emits evidence_total unconditionally, including zero. The consumer reuses the integer-total truncation predicate and derives its hidden count from anchors actually rendered, so malformed, legacy, and reader-refused entries do not fabricate a count. The executed page tests independently cover capped, under-cap, zero, malformed-total, singular/plural, rejected-link, arithmetic, predicate, and card-vs-row behavior, while producer tests cover removal of the former read cap and all-drop diagnostics. No trust check is weakened, no unsafe URL is published, and no hostile reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff.
